topics.label: Lecture introduction
topics.groupedBecause: It frames the lecture topic, difficulty, and context without introducing substantive course content.

topics.label: Complement system overview and C3 mechanics
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics establish the fundamental organisation, naming conventions, and central biochemical role of C3 in the complement cascade.

topics.label: Complement activation pathways
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the three upstream pathways and concentration thresholds that drive complement activation on pathogen surfaces.

topics.label: Effector mechanisms of complement
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail the downstream effector processes by which activated complement clears pathogens and drives inflammation.

topics.label: Regulation and host protection
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explains the regulatory factors that prevent complement activation from damaging host tissues.

topics.label: Clinical complement deficiencies
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explores the diverse clinical presentations and disease phenotypes resulting from deficiencies in specific complement components.

topics.label: Pathogen evasion strategies
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic examines how pathogens subvert complement mechanisms and how these bacterial factors are applied in medicine and research.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion
topics.groupedBecause: It concludes the session, wraps up the lecture block, and previews the next topic.
